items.title: nginx2root: A simple test for the HTTP/2 flaw and three use-after-free reproductions
items.description: Executive Summary Background On 18 November 2026, Xint disclosed five nginx vulnerabilities called nginx2root. Each vulnerability affects memory in an nginx worker process and requires a specific feature: HTTP/2, reverse proxying over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3, runtime DNS resolution with subrequests, or mail proxy authentication.
